title: “Sometimes You Just Have to Think: ‘What Will Make People Laugh?'”: Lolly Adefope on Gags, ‘Ghosts’ and Her West End Debut
summary: It's only fitting that one of the industry's most brilliant comedic actors should take on theater's biggest diva in 'Oh, Mary!': "I had these weird thoughts. I was like, 'I'm going to forget to go to the theater.'"

title: All 17 Quentin Tarantino Movies, Ranked From Worst to Best
summary: As ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’ brings back Brad Pitt’s legendary stuntman, we look back on the ‘Once Upon a Time in Hollywood’ creator’s career of unchained pulp fiction, inglorious grindhouse flicks, natural born Bill-killers and the occasional true romance.

title: ‘Clashing Through the Snow’ Director Carlson Young on Going From “Horror Girly” to Holiday Rom-Com
summary: The director and former 'Scream' star talks about finding the "psychic predator" in a holiday road-trip romance, filming with her daughter and telling more romance stories — while staying ready to bring her "horror fangs out."

title: ‘Hunger Games’ Producer Admits ‘Mockingjay’ Should Have Been One Movie
summary: Franchise producer Nina Jacobson says adapting one book into two movies rubs fans the wrong way: "I think audiences find it cynical."

title: Jenn Kuzmyk to Exit Banff World Media Festival as Executive Director
summary: After nine years leading the annual Rocky Mountains industry retreat, she will step down on Dec. 11.

title: Ben Affleck Negotiates With a Duck as Artists Equity Kicks Off Thanksgiving Campaign for Aflac
summary: The launch of the campaign on the NBC Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade follows Aflac and Affleck's Artists Equity teaming up earlier this year.

title: Gotham Film & Media Institute Names 2026 Winners of Focus Features Student Short Film Showcase (Exclusive)
summary: The five winners will each receive a cash grant and have the opportunity for their short to be shown on Focus Features' digital streaming platform.

title: Mindy Kaling Will Be Honored With The Hollywood Reporter’s Equity in Entertainment Award at Women in Entertainment Gala
summary: Maitreyi Ramakrishnan is set to present Kaling with the award at the Los Angeles event, which is presented by founding sponsor Lifetime and title sponsor Lilly. Mary Beth Barone will open the program.

title: Ava DuVernay to Receive London Critics’ Circle Inaugural Laura Mulvey Female Trailblazer Award
summary: The newly created honor, which DuVernay will collect from Mulvey herself at the London Critics' Circle Film Awards, recognizes the most influential women in film working to break the glass ceiling.

title: ‘The Body’ Star Kristina Bogic Just Wanted to Take Care of Anya: “A Lot of Young Women Can Relate”
summary: The 19-year-old star of Netflix's latest hit breaks down how she came to love her dance team captain character: "Anya always wants to try and do the right thing."
